notes: v2.17.0 — Content ka hissa mukammal: Image Manager (Video Manager ki tarah — ek Page chunein, us ki photos dekhein, download ya remove karein), nayi Content Library (apni images/videos ek jagah mehfooz rakhein, kisi bhi Page ke upload folder mein ek click se bhejein), aur Upload Manager mein drag-and-drop — video files ghaseet kar chhorein, seedha Page ke folder mein chali jayengi.
